definitions.explanation: Being selected as a winner in a lottery, raffle, or prize drawing.
Being elected to office or successfully winning a vote.

examples.japanese: {宝|たから}くじに{当選|とうせん}した。
{抽選|ちゅうせん}の{結果|けっか}、{当選|とうせん}しました。
examples.english: As a result of the drawing, you have won.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{市長|しちょう}{選挙|せんきょ}で{当選|とうせん}した。

notes:
USAGE:
{当選|とうせん} is used for both lotteries and elections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{当選|とうせん}する (to win)
・{当選|とうせん}{番号|ばんごう} (winning number)
・{当選|とうせん}{者|しゃ} (winner)
・{当選|とうせん}{通知|つうち} (notification of winning)
・{当選|とうせん}おめでとうございます (congratulations on winning)

ELECTION COLLOCATIONS:
・{初|はつ}{当選|とうせん} (first-time election victory)
・{再|さい}{当選|とうせん} (re-election)
・{当選|とうせん}{確実|かくじつ} (certain to win)
